meaning:
οἰνο-πότης, -ου, ὁ
(οίνος + πότης, a drinker), poët. and late prose, [in LXX: Pro.23:20 (יַיִן סָבָא)* ;]
a wine-drinker, wine-bibber: Mat.11:19, Luk.7:34.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is…
The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
